## Learning goals

- fit STL;
- estimate Guerrero $\lambda$ and decompose on a transformed scale.

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```

## 1. STL

```{r}
aus_production |>
  model(STL(Beer ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```

## 2. Box–Cox + STL

```{r}
lambda <- aus_production |> features(Beer, guerrero) |> pull(lambda_guerrero)
lambda
aus_production |>
  model(STL(box_cox(Beer, lambda))) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot()
```

## DELIVERABLE

Report $\lambda$ and whether the transformed remainder looks cleaner.
